text:
maria-sales: Heads-up  Acme POC stalled. Hosted API calls fine, but when we tried to flip them to the Dedicated VPC pool users fail to provision and SAML logins are rejected. Need triage.
ida-se: Which dedicated tenant & region? Any error payloads?
maria-sales: Tenant: dedicated-pool-7 in eu-west-1. SCIM calls returning 403 and SAML login gives invalid_response.
chris-acme: Noted. We rotated our SCIM secret this morning and started seeing 403s. SAML worked earlier this week.
devon-eng: Can you paste the exact Authorization header used for SCIM token? Also which SCIM endpoint host are you calling (public vs tenant private host)?
chris-acme: Header: `Authorization: Bearer eyJ....` Scope included `scim:write`. We were pointed at the public api.scim.redwood-inference.com endpoint initially, then switched to `dedicated-pool-7.scim.redwood-inference.private`.
kelly-sre: Important: on Dedicated the SCIM token must be tenant-scoped. Tokens minted for public/hosted clients are rejected by tenant gate. Also we validate request source against VPC egress ranges.
maria-sales: Their curl from the SCIM host in eu-west-1 failed. Error log attached in thread.
onboarding-bot: 2025-02-14T09:12:01Z - SCIM PUT /scim/v2/Users/chr_890 -> 403 {"error":"permission_denied","detail":"token_scope_mismatch"}
onboarding-bot: 2025-02-14T09:12:22Z - SAML processing -> rejected {"reason":"DestinationMismatch","expected":"https://dedicated-pool-7.auth.redwood-inference.private/saml/acs","received":"https://dedicated-pool-7.auth.redwood-inference.private/saml/acs/"}
ida-se: Two independent issues: 1) token scope mismatch for SCIM; 2) ACS URL sent by IdP has trailing slash causing DestinationMismatch. Both common during quick POC rotations.
devon-eng: Proposed fixes: A) Issue tenant-scoped SCIM token and share via secure vault; B) Add a normalized ACS accept rule for this tenant that tolerates trailing slash for 72h while Acme updates their SP metadata.
chris-acme: Prefer we don't touch IdP today. Can Redwood accept the trailing slash for the POC window?
raj-security: Accepting a normalization rule is OK temporarily if we log and audit it. We'll require approval from sales and schedule automatic rollback.
maria-sales: Approved for 72 hours. Also please create new SCIM token scoped to tenant and send via secure channel.
devon-eng: Actions: 1) Create tenant-scoped SCIM token and deliver via secure vault; 2) Deploy ACS normalization for dedicated-pool-7 (accept with/without trailing slash) for 72h with audit logging; 3) Re-run provisioning tests and paste results.
devon-eng: SCIM token issued and delivered to Chris via secure vault. ACS normalization rule deployed at 2025-02-14T09:18:40Z with audit note.
onboarding-bot: 2025-02-14T09:19:10Z - SCIM PUT /scim/v2/Users/chr_890 -> 200 OK
onboarding-bot: 2025-02-14T09:19:36Z - SAML processed -> success {"user":"chris.acme@example.com","auth_time":"2025-02-14T09:19:34Z"}
chris-acme: Confirmed. Provisioning and SAML login work now. Thanks for the quick help! :tada:
maria-sales: Follow-ups: I'll update the POC ticket noting the temporary normalization and token issuance. Ask Acme to update their SP metadata (remove trailing slash) before rollback. Also confirm we will rotate the SCIM token and remove normalization after 72h.
raj-security: We'll schedule automatic rotation and normalization removal in 72 hours and capture audit entries.
ida-se: Marking provisioning unblocked. Next steps: load testing and pricing estimate.
